metadata.name: Playable Gello : ReFed!
metadata.description:
This mod adds : [list] [*] 1 new character with it tainted version (you have to unlock it) [*] 14 new items [*] 3 new trinkets [*] 2 new consumables [*] 1 new slot variant [/list]
[h2]Gello[/h2] Starts with 2 red hearts and 1 black heart Double tapping the fire keys makes gello bite Killing enemies this way will grants a temporary damage up Holding Ctrl (or the drop trinket button) near an item, Gello will gain a some damage and temporary damage * some items may grant more or less stats and some others do an extra effect [h3]!!Repentogon Only!![/h3] Gello would be locked but if you already defeated mom a pop up will appear asking if you want to keep Gello locked Gello can be unlocked by defeating the lamb as any character
[h2]Tainted Gello[/h2] It depends with which class you select :)
[h1]Main Compatibility[/h1] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=836319872]External Item Description[/url] (spanish and english) [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2376005362]Encyclopedia[/url] [/list]
Press c to configure the mod or to unlock everything
[url=https://moddingofisaac.wiki.gg/wiki/Playable_Gello_:_ReFed!]Mod Wiki[/url]
Not really important side note because some people in youtube comment section (3 as far i count) discusses gello gender Idk man i couldn't decide it when i made them. that it. I hope this clarifies things. Bye :P
also tarnish version is still in the plans
